name: Alchemy Laboratory
what: Use: Places an Alchemy Laboratory usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Mana Well. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Mana Well to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Fermenter
what: Use: Places a fermenter that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all of the benefits of a Mana Well. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Mana Well to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Flask of Natural Accuracy
what: Use: Increases your Stamina by 30. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 2% Hit Chance. Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Flask of Natural Aggression
what: Use: Increases your Stamina by 30. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 2% Critical Strike Chance. Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Flask of Natural Precision
what: Use: Increases your Stamina by 30. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 2% reduced chance to be dodged or parried. Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Flask of Natural Swiftness
what: Use: Increases your Stamina by 30. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 2% Haste. Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Mana Well
what: Use: Constructs a mana well that allows you and others sitting nearby to regenerate 29 Mana every 5 sec, mutually exclusive with Blessing of Wisdom. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Anvil
what: Use: Places an anvil, and provides all of the benefits of a Sharpening Wheel. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Sharpening Wheel to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Arcanite Blacksmith Hammer
what: Chance on hit: Stun the target for 1 sec.

name: Master Forge
what: Use: Places a Master Forge usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Sharpening Wheel. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Sharpening Wheel to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Mithril Blacksmith Hammer
what: Chance on hit: Concuss the target, slowing movement speed by 20% for 6 sec.

name: Sharpening Wheel
what: Use: Constructs a sharpening wheel that grants you and others sitting nearby 34 increased Strength, mutually exclusive with Strength of Earth Totem. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Basic Campfire Kit
what: Use: Builds a basic campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 3 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Cookie's Feast
what: Use: Lay out Cookie's Feast that contains Stamina-boosting food. Requires a Cooking Fire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Expert Campfire Kit
what: Use: Builds an expert campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 10 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Iron Oven
what: Use: Places an Iron Oven required for the most advanced cooking recipes. Requires a Cooking Fire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Journeyman Campfire Kit
what: Use: Builds a journeyman campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 5 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Savory Whimsyfin Delight
what: Use: Eat me. (10 Sec Cooldown)

name: Arcane Forge
what: Use: Places an Arcane Forge usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of an Enchanted Lute. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over an Enchanted Lute to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Arcane Salvager
what: Use: Places an Arcane Salvager that enables more efficient disenchanting, and provides all the benefits of an Enchanted Lute. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over an Enchanted Lute to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Dormant Heart of the Mountain
what: Equip: Your casts of Greater Heal, Healing Touch, Healing Wave, or Holy Light in combat grant up to 40 increased healing and up to 13 increased damage for 15 sec.

name: Enchanted Lute
what: Use: Summons an enchanted lute that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 308 Armor, 13 increase to all stats, and 22 increase to all resistances, mutually exclusive with Mark of the Wild. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Frozen Heart of the Mountain
what: Use: Increases Frost and Shadow spell damage done by up to 29 for 15 sec. This effect is doubled in Snowy areas. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Idol of Swiftness
what: Equip: Reduces the cooldown of your Swiftmend spell by 3 sec.

name: Idol of the Ursine Twins
what: Equip: Your Lacerate hits have a 10% chance to reset the cooldown on Primal Bite.

name: Libram of Invocation
what: Equip: Reduces the mana cost of your Seal spells by 5%.

name: Molten Heart of the Mountain
what: Use: Increases Attack Power by 55 for 15 sec. This effect is doubled in Volcanic areas. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Mystic Mushroom
what: Equip: Increases Spirit by 5%.

name: Polished Driftwood Icon
what: Equip: Allows 8% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

name: Talons of Wrath
what: Equip: Causes Wrath to have a 50% chance to restore 35 Mana.

name: Tenets of the Silver Hand
what: Equip: Increases your damage against Undead by 1%.

name: Totem of Ancestral Protection
what: Equip: Reduces the cooldown of Grounding Totem by 1 sec.

name: Anarchist's Workbench
what: Use: Places an Anarchist's Workbench usable for recipes that require it. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Bent Goggles
what: Use: Allows you to look far into the distance.

name: Compact Critter Carrier
what: Use: Place a Compact Critter Carrier for 3 min that allows Hunters in your group to access their stabled pets. (30 Min Cooldown)

name: Dented Goggles
what: Use: Allows you to look far into the distance.

name: Dimensional Transporter - Mt. Hyjal
what: Use: Rips the dimensional walls asunder and transports you to Kaylaena's Workshop on Mount Hyjal. Technical problems have a high chance to occur with this mad combination of goblin and gnomish engineering. (4 Hr Cooldown)

name: EZ-Thro Copper Bomb XL
what: Use: Inflicts 43 to 57 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5 yd radius for 1 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: EZ-Thro Grenade
what: Use: Inflicts 213 to 287 Fire damage in a 5 yd radius. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade
what: Use: Inflicts 300 to 500 Fire damage and stuns targets for 3 sec in a 3 yd radius. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Emergency Field Cloak
what: Use: Gives invisibility for 10 sec. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Floppy Goggles
what: Use: Allows you to look far into the distance.

name: Gnomish Poultryizer
what: Use: Turns the target into a chicken for 15 sec. Well, that is assuming the transmogrification polarity has not been reversed... (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Harvester Override Signalcaster
what: Use: Override control of the target mechanical creature for up to 3 min. The target will attack slower while under your control. Ineffective on targets above level 18. (3 Min Cooldown)

name: Loot-A-Rang
what: Use: Retrieves the loot from a nearby corpse. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Reagent Bot
what: Use: Summons a Reagent Bot that allows you and others nearby to purchase reagents. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Repair Bot
what: Use: Summons a Repair Bot that allows you and others nearby to buy reagents and repair gear. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Reagent Bot to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Bomb
what: Use: Inflicts 149 to 201 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5 yd radius for 3 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Bronze Bomb
what: Use: Inflicts 73 to 97 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 3 yd radius for 2 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Clever Dynamite
what: Use: Inflicts 340 to 460 Fire damage in a 5 yd radius. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Copper Bomb
what: Use: Inflicts 22 to 28 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 3 yd radius for 1 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Dynamite
what: Use: Inflicts 26 to 34 Fire damage in a 5 yd radius. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Jumbo Dynamite
what: Use: Inflicts 128 to 172 Fire damage in a 5 yd radius. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Satchel of Bronze Bombs
what: Equip: Thrown attacks explode on impact, causing 2 to 19 Fire damage to nearby enemies.

name: Satchel of Copper Bombs
what: Equip: Thrown attacks explode on impact, causing 1 to 11 Fire damage to nearby enemies.

name: Satchel of Dark Iron Bombs
what: Equip: Thrown attacks explode on impact, causing 4 to 37 Fire damage to nearby enemies.

name: Satchel of Iron Bombs
what: Equip: Thrown attacks explode on impact, causing 3 to 30 Fire damage to nearby enemies.

name: Stealthman 52
what: Use: Cloaks the user in a stealth field for up to 1 min. Cannot be used in combat. The field lasts for up to 6 sec after moving. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Stuckbutton Goggles
what: Use: Allows you to look far into the distance.

name: Tru-Trigger Frag Bomb
what: Use: Inflicts 149 to 201 Fire damage and stuns targets in an 8 yd radius for 2 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Ultralight Goblin Glider
what: Use: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Ultrasafe Rechargeable Battery
what: Use: Restores 3 charges to a SAF-T or EZ-Thro brand device in your possession that does not involve explosions. It would be completely Unsafe with explosives. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: First Aid Kit
what: Use: Unpacks a first aid kit that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 56 increased Stamina, mutually exclusive with Power Word: Fortitude. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Plague Doctor's Laboratory
what: Use: Places a Plague Doctor's Laboratory that contains healing potions and poultices, and provides all of the benefits of a First Aid Kit. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a First Aid Kit to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Toxin Study
what: Use: Places a Toxin Study that contains healing potions and anti-venom, and provides all of the benefits of a First Aid Kit. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a First Aid Kit to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Fish Bowl
what: Use: Places a small fish bowl that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 8% increased stats, mutually exclusive with Blessing of Kings. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Fishing Hut
what: Use: Places a Fishing Hut that grants the ability to catch rare fish for 1 hour, provides Fishing Skill lures, and provides all of the benefits of a Fish Bowl. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Fish Bowl to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Fishing Rack
what: Use: Places a Fishing Rack that grants the ability to catch uncommon fish for 1 hour, provides Fishing Skill lures, and provides all of the benefits of a Fish Bowl. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Fish Bowl to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Greenhouse
what: Use: Places a Greenhouse that will grow herbs over time from seeds planted, and provides all of the benefits of an Incense Candle. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over an Incense Candle to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Incense Candle
what: Use: Ignites an incense candle that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 25 increased Intellect, mutually exclusive with Arcane Intellect. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Seed Hybridizer
what: Use: Places a Seed Hybridizer that allows seeds to be multiplied or combined into rarer tiers, and provides all of the benefits of an Incense Candle. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over an Incense Candle to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Camp Tent
what: Use: Builds a tent that allows you and others sitting nearby to increase Rested experience to 5% of a level. No effect if Rested experience already exceeds that value. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Sewing Machine
what: Use: Places a Sewing Machine usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Camp Tent. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Camp Tent to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Tanning Rack
what: Use: Places a Tanning Rack that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all of the benefits of a Camp Tent. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Camp Tent to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Lodestone
what: Use: Erects a lodestone that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 90 increased melee Attack Power, mutually exclusive with Blessing of Might. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Molten Foundry
what: Use: Places a Molten Foundry usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of a Lodestone. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Lodestone to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Rock Garden
what: Use: Places a Rock Garden that spawns a common mining node over time, and provides all the benefits of a Lodestone. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Lodestone to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Camp Chair
what: Use: Assembles a camp chair that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 2% increased critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, mutually exclusive with Moonkin Aura. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Field Guide
what: Use: Places a Field Guide that allows players to read it and gain Track Beasts, and provides all the benefits of a Camp Chair. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Camp Chair to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Trapper's Workbench
what: Use: Places a Trapper's Workbench containing 1 trap, and provides all the benefits of a Camp Chair. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Camp Chair to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Faction Banner
what: Use: Unrolls a banner that allows you and other members of the Horde sitting nearby to gain 32 increased Spirit, mutually exclusive with Divine Spirit. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Faction Banner
what: Use: Unrolls a banner that allows you and other members of the Alliance sitting nearby to gain 32 increased Spirit, mutually exclusive with Divine Spirit. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Loom
what: Use: Places a Loom usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of a Faction Banner. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Faction Banner to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Spinning Wheel
what: Use: Places a Spinning Wheel that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all the benefits of a Faction Banner. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Faction Banner to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)
